note: Opening scene establishes the crime, setting, key people present and physical clues; acts as the setup for the investigation.
Forensic traces (missing screw, filings, rasp) deepen the locked-room puzzle and create a misleading but plausible suspect theatre around Owen; tension builds.
Forensic reconstruction and reveal — scene pays off prior promises and narrows suspect criteria; tension peaks as device is demonstrated and evidence points to an insider with mechanical skill.
Confrontation and confession resolve the central mystery; scene provides moral closure and arrests the suspect; tension peaks and then begins release.
